turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Hey Dev, good to see you again. How are your spirits holding up after last week?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey Wren. Better, actually. I took the weekend to step away from the computer, and then I checked my inbox this morning.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Stepping away helps clear the air. What was waiting in your inbox?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Some good news, I think. Vireline Health sent over a SQL take-home challenge, and the deadline to submit it is Monday, October fifth.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That is great news, Dev. How do you feel about a take-home compared to the live coding at Tarnwell?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, it feels like a relief. Having someone stare at me while I type a join was brutal, so being able to work at my own desk is way better.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Take-homes let you pause and check your work. Did they give you a sense of what the dataset looks like?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not yet, I haven't unzipped the prompt file. I wanted to wait until tonight after dinner so I could sit down without distractions.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That makes total sense. Have you thought about how you want to pace it between now and October fifth?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, my thought was to read the questions tonight, sketch out the joins over the next few days, and leave the weekend for polishing.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Spreading it out keeps the pressure low. Do you want to do a walkthrough together once you have your queries drafted?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'd really like that, yeah. In case they ask me to explain my trade-offs or why I chose a subquery over a CTE.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: We can definitely pick apart your reasoning and practice saying it cleanly. What is your plan for getting started tonight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just make a cup of tea, open the schema, and read the prompt without touching the keyboard.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: A quiet first look is smart. Is there anything else on your mind before you wrap up for the day?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, that's really all I had for today. Thanks for listening, Wren, it feels good to have some momentum again.
